title: Ten-tribe politics: proposing Apis would be madness—far likelier Jehovah under calf-symbols like cherubim or the bronze serpent
source_text: XXXIX. Et certe cum Israelitae, quos Jeroboam sibi subjicere, & a Domo David abducere volebat, Jehovam solum Deum agnoscerent, & ex lege Mosis viverent, non potuit ille, nisi summa dementia, iis proponere cultum Apis, vel alterius numinis Aegyptiaci, salva spe retinendi imperii. Quare longe probabilius est, eum voluisse Jehovam coli in vitulis, tanquam in symbolis praesentiae divinae, ad instar Cherubinorum, vel serpentis aenei.
pass_a_gloss: And certainly when the Israelites, whom Jeroboam wished to subject to himself, and to lead away from the House of David, acknowledged Jehovah alone as God, and lived from the law of Moses, he could not, except by highest madness, propose to them the cult of Apis, or of another Egyptian divinity, with hope of retaining the empire safe. Wherefore it is far more probable that he wished Jehovah to be cultivated in the calves, as in symbols of the divine presence, after the likeness of the Cherubim, or of the brazen serpent.
pass_b_english: A Mosaic people would revolt at Apis; empire-hope rules that out.
Better parallel: calves as presence-symbols like cherubim or the bronze serpent.

choices.english: of the Cherubim, or of the brazen serpent
